observations.observation: Query requested entity home, but retrieval returned work entity Paris first and answered incorrectly; entity filtering is disabled.
Query requested entity primary, but retrieval returned project-6 Bath first instead of primary Berlin.
As-of 2026-01-05 returned future/current Paris rather than Berlin, showing that temporal filtering is disabled.
As-of 2026-01-05 returned Paris whose valid_from is 2026-01-10, rather than Berlin.
Three identical historical records were retrieved, indicating avoidable retrieval distraction, though deduplication is not being changed in this proposal.

hypothesis: Enabling entity and as-of-date filtering will prevent cross-entity distractors and exclude records outside the requested validity interval, improving complete-scenario task success without changing admission or ownership behavior.
predicted_effect: Entity-grounding and distractor-retrieval should select the requested entity; historical-address, future-move, and history-boundary should select the record valid at the requested as-of date. Hard-constraint behavior should remain unchanged.
